work_title: Fix sortDirection and deterministic global_index ordering for v1 boxes byAddress / byErgoTree (#263)
description: Wired sortDirection (defaulting to desc) into v1 BoxesEndpointDefs (getOutputsByAddressDef / getApiV1BoxesByaddressP1 and getOutputsByErgoTreeDef / getApiV1BoxesByergotreeP1), BoxesRoutes, Boxes, OutputRepo.streamAllByErgoTree, v0 BoxesService, and TestOutputRepo, and added deterministic global_index ordering with bounded Top-N pagination + LEFT JOIN LATERAL in OutputQuerySet.getMainByErgoTree, verified with multi-page and multi-chunk PostgreSQL/Redis Testcontainers tests in OutputRepoSpec and BoxSpec.
